column1: # Which way a lift goes, by hand. The install does not say which of two modules lies lower.
# Columns, split by one tab: module the lift is taken in, module it leads to, direction (down up level), seconds the ride takes.
# A row is also read the other way round (down becomes up). A lift with no row is level and takes the default.
# GUESSED from the names (Upper City > Lower City > Outcasts/Undercity); the owner edits these. Add more rows the same way.
